title: The Day the Dunes Sang
description: On the first windy morning of autumn, three travelers come to listen. The dune curls into a horn and spills a ribbon of sand as it sings.
alt: Three small travelers cup their ears beneath a huge golden dune shaped like a gramophone horn. Sand falls from its lip against a clear blue sky.
pairing: An imagined first-wind holiday × a dune that sings like a giant horn
